title: Slay the Alice
description:
Alice wandered into a land full of plants like nothing she'd ever seen before.

This is the story of Alice and friends' adventure in a pixel-art world that's just like a storybook, told with adorable animations.

Advance through the map with Alice, and aim to reach various endings!

 

■Slay the Alice is a short visual-novel adventure. 

All you'll need to use is a mouse.

Within a single map, you'll choose which path to take, read randomly-occurring stories, and choose Alice's actions.

There are no difficult action elements, battles, or deduction elements involved.

■How to Play

Make choices, gather flowers, and reach the end of the map.

■Features

・A short experience with around 30 minutes of playtime

・Simple mouse-only controls

・No action gameplay, battles, or deduction elements

・Contains a few horror elements and graphic depictions

・Four endings (and one bonus ending)

■Multiple Endings

Alice's actions will slightly affect what ending you get.

Once all other endings are obtained, it will unlock an bonus ending.

■Game Streaming and Creative Guidelines

 

We welcome game streaming, live broadcasts, and fan creations.

 For game streaming, live broadcasts, be sure to paste the URL for "Slay the Alice" on Steam in the summary field.

 Monetization is also allowed without any issues.
description_short: A short visual novel presented with pixel art and cute animations. Chasing after a rabbit, Alice found herself in a land of talking plants. Now, it's time to go on a tiny little adventure.
